lead: Makes, scores, and fixes plugins against one rubric: use when making or improving a plugin or its skills, or when the person asks for a plugin to be scored or a marketplace checkout to be reinstalled.

improve-plugin.cue: raise an existing plugin's score, fix scorecard findings

create-plugin.cue: make a new plugin, or wrap existing skills or scripts

evaluate-plugin.cue: score a plugin into a scorecard with a verdict

refresh-marketplace.cue: reinstall a marketplace from the working tree
